name: @trakkit/ui
description: Beech & Baize — the trakkit design system. Painted wooden pieces on a baize board.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp src/*.css dist/ && mkdir -p dist/fonts && cp src/fonts/*.woff2 dist/fonts/ && cat src/fonts.css src/tokens.css src/components.css > dist/styles.css && mkdir -p guides && cp ../../DESIGN.md guides/beech-and-baize.md
